import math
import unittest

from solution import continuous_headings


class ContinuousHeadingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_first_value_and_float_results(self):
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([]), [])
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([725]), [725.0])
        result = continuous_headings([10, 20])
        self.assertTrue(all(type(value) is float for value in result))

    def test_wraps_by_full_turns_in_both_directions(self):
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([350, 10, 20]), [350.0, 370.0, 380.0])
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([10, 350, 340]), [10.0, -10.0, -20.0])
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([10, 1090, -1070]), [10.0, 10.0, 10.0])

    def test_custom_limit_and_exact_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([5, 355], 30), [5.0, -5.0])
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([10, 40, 10], 30), [10.0, 40.0, 10.0])
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([0, 180, 0], 180), [0.0, 180.0, 0.0])
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([0, -180], 180), [0.0, -180.0])

    def test_input_is_unchanged_and_result_is_new(self):
        values = [350, 10]
        result = continuous_headings(values)
        self.assertEqual(values, [350, 10])
        self.assertIsNot(result, values)

    def test_values_validation(self):
        for values in (None, (), "10"):
            with self.subTest(values=values):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    continuous_headings(values)
        for value in (True, "1", None):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    continuous_headings([value])
        for value in (float("inf"), float("-inf"), float("nan")):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    continuous_headings([value])

    def test_jump_limit_validation(self):
        for limit in (True, False, "10", None):
            with self.subTest(limit=limit):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    continuous_headings([], limit)
        for limit in (0, -1, 180.0001, float("inf"), float("nan")):
            with self.subTest(limit=limit):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    continuous_headings([], limit)
        self.assertEqual(continuous_headings([], 180), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
